decision.blocker: The observed runtime is CPython 3.11.0 with OpenSSL 1.1.1q. Python is unpatched relative to the current 3.11.17 security release, OpenSSL 1.1.1 is past public end of life, and the production target runtime is unresolved.

connector.integration_boundary: HTTPX public BaseTransport plus HTTP Core documented ConnectionPool and NetworkBackend interfaces
connector.dial_behavior: Policy resolves and validates all answers; per-hop backend dials a numeric pinned answer without hostname resolution; HTTP Core receives the original hostname for Host, SNI, and certificate hostname verification.
connector.redirects: Manual, exact-host checked each hop, re-resolved, loop-detected, bounded.
connector.body_limit: Streaming decoded response bytes are counted; Content-Length is not trusted.

api_stability.proof: Local HTTPS socket tests established numeric-IP dialing, original-host certificate validation, wrong-host rejection, and untrusted-CA rejection with the pinned versions.

tests.command: uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements-test.lock python -m pytest tests/test_safe_http_transport.py -q
mock_evidence: mixed DNS answer fails before transport creation
fresh resolution and changed pinned answer per redirect (rebinding case), denied/disallowed target, redirect loop and hop limit
local_socket_evidence: HTTPS test server reached through pinned loopback IP while request used unresolved shop.example hostname
original Host header and local endpoint verified
read timeout and transport-level overall deadline observed
limits: Rejected redirect zero-connector evidence is mocked, not a local target socket counter
No deterministic connect-timeout or complete overall-deadline test
Special-purpose and transition IPv6 policy needs broader review
Synchronous system DNS resolution is not bounded by the overall deadline

dependencies.httpcore_selection_reason: 1.0.9 includes the release-note fix for GHSA-vqfr-h8mv-ghfj; 1.0.9 is compatible with HTTPX 0.28.1.

runtime.python_status: 3.11 remains security-fix-only supported through October 2027; installed 3.11.0 is superseded by 3.11.17.
